title: TaskList
description: The developer model's decomposition of one bean, produced in the specifying stage and audited with the spec. Lives at factory/specs/<bean-id>/tasks.yaml. Each task is the unit of the build loop: start -> complete -> verify -> next. The controller drives the loop; the model never marks its own task verified.

intent.description: One outcome, small enough to finish and verify in a single worker session.

write_paths.description: Must be a subset of the bean's effective write paths; the controller rejects the task list otherwise.

satisfies.description: Acceptance criteria this task contributes to. Every AC must be claimed by at least one task.

verify.description: Run by the controller after the worker declares the task complete. All must pass before the next task starts.

teaching_note.description: Why this step exists, for the implementation-detail document. Written for a reader who does not know the stack.
